name: create_axum_crud_todos
description: Creates an in-memory Axum /todos CRUD API (GET, POST, DELETE)
prompts:
This Cargo project (Cargo.toml already lists axum, tokio, serde, and serde_json as dependencies) needs a src/main.rs. Using Axum, build an in-memory /todos resource with shared state (protected by a Mutex, wrapped in an Arc, created once in main and shared via State) that supports:
- GET /todos: returns 200 with a JSON array of all todos created so far. Each todo is a JSON object with an integer "id" and a string "title".
- POST /todos: accepts a JSON body {"title": "..."}, assigns it a new unique integer id (starting at 1 and increasing by 1 for each new todo, even across the whole server run), stores it, and returns 201 Created with the created todo (including its assigned id) as JSON.
- DELETE /todos/:id: removes the todo with that id if it exists and returns 204 No Content; if no todo has that id, returns 404 Not Found instead.
Todos must persist across requests within the same server run. Have the server listen on 0.0.0.0:8041.

setup_files.Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "todos_crud"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]
axum = "0.7"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"

test_setup_files.test_todos.py:
import subprocess, sys, time, json, urllib.request, urllib.error, os

def req(method, path, body=None):
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    r = urllib.request.Request(f'http://127.0.0.1:8041{path}', data=data, method=method)
    if data is not None:
        r.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=3) as resp:
            payload = resp.read()
            return resp.status, (json.loads(payload) if payload else None)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        payload = e.read()
        try:
            parsed = json.loads(payload) if payload else None
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            parsed = None
        return e.code, parsed

subprocess.run(['cargo', 'build', '--offline'], check=True)
srv = subprocess.Popen([os.path.join(os.environ.get('CARGO_TARGET_DIR', 'target'), 'debug', 'todos_crud')])
try:
    ok = False
    status = body = None
    for _ in range(30):
        try:
            status, body = req('GET', '/todos')
            ok = True
            break
        except (urllib.error.URLError, ConnectionResetError):
            time.sleep(0.5)
    assert ok, 'server never became reachable on :8041'
    assert status == 200 and body == [], f'expected empty list initially, got {status} {body!r}'

    status, body = req('POST', '/todos', {'title': 'buy milk'})
    assert status == 201, f'expected 201, got {status}'
    assert body['title'] == 'buy milk' and body['id'] == 1, f'unexpected body: {body!r}'

    status, body = req('POST', '/todos', {'title': 'walk dog'})
    assert status == 201
    assert body['id'] == 2, f'expected second id to be 2, got {body!r}'

    status, body = req('GET', '/todos')
    assert status == 200 and len(body) == 2, f'expected 2 todos, got {body!r}'

    status, _ = req('DELETE', '/todos/1')
    assert status == 204, f'expected 204 on delete, got {status}'

    status, body = req('GET', '/todos')
    assert status == 200 and len(body) == 1, f'expected 1 todo remaining, got {body!r}'
    assert body[0]['id'] == 2 and body[0]['title'] == 'walk dog', f'unexpected remaining todo: {body[0]!r}'

    status, _ = req('DELETE', '/todos/999')
    assert status == 404, f'expected 404 deleting nonexistent id, got {status}'
finally:
    srv.terminate()
    try:
        srv.wait(timeout=5)
    except Exception:
        srv.kill()
print('PASS')
